Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Reduced fan airflow or fan-current abnormality raises heat-sink/junction temperature; controller derates or trips to protect power electronics.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Heat-sink temperature rise|Fan-current deviation|Thermal derating alarm|Cooling fan alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Verify fan command and current; measure airflow; compare heat-sink temperature at equivalent load; inspect filters/fan bearings.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: PCC/feeder voltage above inverter ride-through or protection threshold causes protective derating or trip; DC-side equipment may remain healthy.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: AC overvoltage alarm|Grid voltage high|Protection relay event|Inverter trip
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Matching_Terms: overvoltage|over voltage|grid voltage|voltage excursion|pcc|feeder voltage|ride through|protection
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Validate PCC/feeder voltage waveform and relay sequence; compare inverter grid-code settings and ride-through thresholds.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Moisture, cable/connector insulation damage or contamination lowers insulation resistance, increasing leakage/earth-fault current and provoking protective shutdown.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Earth-fault indication|Insulation-resistance decline|DC leakage alarm|Moisture finding
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Measure insulation resistance by isolated DC section; inspect connectors/cables for moisture and damage; verify leakage trend before re-energization.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: IGBT/MOSFET/diode thermal stress or poor thermal interface raises semiconductor temperature independent of normal ambient/load response, leading to derating or trip.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Power-stage temperature rise|Thermal derating alarm|Phase temperature imbalance|Repeated high-temperature trip
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Matching_Terms: igbt|power stage|semiconductor|junction temperature|phase temperature|thermal stress|thermal trip
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Compare phase/power-stage temperatures at equivalent load; inspect thermal interface and heatsink coupling; correlate with switching/load history.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Loss of fan/pump/cooling-bank effectiveness reduces heat rejection, causing oil and winding temperatures to rise together under normal loading.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Oil-temperature rise|Winding-temperature deviation|Cooling-bank alarm|Fan/pump status alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Matching_Terms: oil temperature|winding temperature|cooling bank|fan pump|pump|radiator|cooling system
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Check cooling-bank command/status, fan and pump currents, radiator temperature differential and load-normalized oil/winding temperatures.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Overcurrent, differential or earth-fault protection operates when measured current/sequence quantities exceed configured protection logic; relay chronology must establish whether operation was primary or consequential.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Differential protection event|Overcurrent relay event|Earth-fault relay event|Relay pre-alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Retrieve relay COMTRADE/disturbance record; verify CT channels, pickup/timing and breaker sequence; distinguish primary fault from sympathetic operation.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Thermal aging, moisture or electrical stress degrades oil-paper insulation, increasing dielectric loss/partial discharge and potentially generating characteristic dissolved gases.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Oil dielectric decline|DGA anomaly|Partial-discharge indication|Insulation resistance decline
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Perform DGA and oil dielectric/moisture tests; insulation resistance/tan-delta as applicable; inspect bushings and thermal history before intrusive work.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Commanded and actual tap position diverge because of mechanism, drive, limit-switch or feedback problems, potentially causing voltage deviation and repeated operations.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Tap-position mismatch|OLTC motor alarm|Tap command without feedback|Voltage regulation deviation
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Compare commanded vs actual tap position and operation counter; inspect motor current, limit switches and mechanism; verify regulated voltage response.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Excess friction, gearbox/drive wear, obstruction or misalignment increases motor torque/current and prevents commanded tracker angle from being achieved.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Position deviation|Motor-current rise|Drive overload|Stall alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Compare commanded vs actual angle and motor current; inspect gearbox/drive train, torque tube alignment and obstruction; verify no wind-stow command is active.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Sensor offset/drift makes reported angle differ from true mechanical angle while drive torque remains normal, causing tracking error without a mechanical stall signature.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Angle mismatch|Position feedback deviation|Calibration alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Measure physical tracker angle independently; compare encoder/sensor feedback across positions; recalibrate and verify repeatability.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: High wind or wind-sensor logic commands stow; apparent tracking loss is expected protective behavior when the command and response are valid.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Wind-stow command|High-wind alarm|Stow angle reached|Wind sensor threshold
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Matching_Terms: wind stow|high wind|stow command|anemometer|wind alarm|stow angle
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Validate wind sensor input, stow threshold/hysteresis, controller command and achieved stow angle; confirm event duration against weather evidence.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Loss of controller power or communications interrupts commands/telemetry; position may freeze or become stale without a mechanical fault.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Controller timeout|Communication alarm|Stale position|Gateway offline
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Check controller power, network/gateway path, communications error counters and timestamp freshness; verify firmware/controller restart history.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Loose, corroded or degraded connector/termination increases contact resistance; I²R heating creates a localized thermal hotspot and voltage loss.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Connector temperature rise|Thermal hotspot|Terminal discoloration|Localized voltage drop
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Perform thermography under load; compare paired connector temperatures and voltage drop; isolate/de-energize before torque/contact inspection.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: A string current materially below peer strings under comparable irradiance indicates open-circuit, fuse/connector, module or shading/mismatch issues requiring localization.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: String-current deviation|DC current imbalance|Low string current|Peer-string mismatch
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Matching_Terms: string current|current imbalance|low current|mismatch|peer string|open circuit
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Compare normalized string currents at common irradiance; inspect fuse/connector continuity and module/string condition; separate shading from electrical loss.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Moisture or damaged cable/termination lowers insulation resistance to ground, producing leakage/earth-fault alarms and potential inverter isolation.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Insulation-resistance decline|Earth-fault indication|Moisture ingress|Leakage current rise
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Segment and insulation-test strings/cables; inspect glands/connectors for moisture/damage; verify ground leakage before restoration.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Fuse element or holder degradation increases resistance/temperature or opens the string, causing current loss; failure must be distinguished from upstream module/string faults.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Fuse-status alarm|Fuse temperature rise|Open string|String current zero
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Verify fuse continuity and voltage across fuse; inspect holder heating/contact pressure; compare string current before replacement.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Abnormal voltage/current/resistance/insulation evidence indicates an electrical degradation mechanism when a more specific governed asset rule is unavailable.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Electrical alarm|Current deviation|Voltage deviation|Insulation finding
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Validate voltage/current/resistance and protection evidence; inspect affected electrical component; refine classification when asset-specific evidence is available.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Temperature materially above comparable operating condition indicates abnormal heat generation or inadequate heat rejection and requires load-normalized confirmation.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Temperature deviation|Thermal hotspot|Overtemperature alarm
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Confirm temperature deviation under comparable load/ambient conditions; inspect heat generation and heat-rejection path.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Loss of power/network/gateway/controller connectivity creates stale or missing telemetry and commands without necessarily implying physical asset failure.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Communication alarm|Stale telemetry|Gateway offline|Timeout
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Check device power, network/gateway path, error counters and timestamp freshness; verify recovery after controlled restart if permitted.

Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Engineering_Basis: Abnormal vibration, alignment, friction, wear or lubrication signatures indicate mechanical deterioration when asset-specific rules are unavailable.
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Trigger_Signals: Vibration deviation|Position deviation|Mechanical inspection finding
Engineering Reference Taxonomy.Verification_Method: Inspect alignment, vibration, wear, fasteners and lubrication; correlate condition with load/speed and maintenance history.

Event Root Cause Cases.Engineering_Basis: Reduced fan airflow or fan-current abnormality raises heat-sink/junction temperature; controller derates or trips to protect power electronics.
